description: Named cases for #230 (D040): the owner's policy rulings from #192's backfill review (2026-10-27 to 28), one case per source row, with the owner's ruling as 'expected' (the human-reviewed brand_labels where they exist). Strata name the ruling ('ruling_1' to 'ruling_9'). 'expected.categories' rules the applicable categories and 'expected.sentiments' their sentiments; ruling 3's sentiments are not ruled (copies of one story may differ) and are read by hand. The ruling 7 and ruling 8 cases test whether the model follows a named instruction (Allbirds and Spyder are named in v1.13.0), not whether it generalizes. 'allbirds_reference' cases are Allbirds named only as a reference point, ruled false_positive in the same review. The ruling 9 case is gray: reported, not scored. On 7de2362b the expected brand is Converse; Nike's labels are read by hand. 'title' is the stored title, kept so the prompt-example check runs without the database; the harness reads the title from the article.
